run_check_include_guards: run the include guard checker script to validate C/C++ header preprocessor guards in the gRPC repository
run_check_include_guards_fix: run the include guard checker with the --fix flag to automatically correct invalid preprocessor guards
run_check_include_guards_precommit: run the include guard checker in precommit mode to check only files changed in the current git diff
build_valid_guard: build the expected preprocessor guard name from a given header file path using the GRPC naming convention
review_GuardValidator_check: review the GuardValidator check method to validate ifndef, define, and endif guards in a C/C++ header file
